name: Mog or Die
desc:
🔥 MOG OR DIE 

Free Clavicular Egg code: freeclavegg

Start as a tiny SUB5 and build yourself into the ultimate MOGGER.

🥛 Drink Milk to grow taller  
🔨 Collect Hammers to improve your Face  
🖼️ Find Picture Frames to build your Frame  
💧 Collect Water to lower your Bodyfat  

Challenge NPCs and real players in MOG BATTLES where your Face, Frame, Height, and Bodyfat are compared.

Win the battle and choose their fate:

🟢 SPARE — Let them keep their run  
🔴 MOG — Erase their progress and earn MogPoints  


⚡ Unlock and roll powerful abilities  
👑 Become the server’s MOG KING  
💰 Hunt players with large bounties  
🌦️ Survive changing weather and world events  
✨ Find rare Golden collectibles  
📦 Fight over Mog Drops  
💪 Defeat special NPCs and bosses  
🧬 Choose unique Genetics for every run  
🏙️ Enter dangerous Risk Zones for better rewards  
🎁 Claim Daily and Playtime Rewards  
🎬 Unlock and equip unique MOG Finishers
